Name: Junimo Cat
Author: cqtxzs
Description:
This is a Content Patcher mod that will turn you're basic kitty into a new and improved green junimo kitty! This is my first mod that I have actually finished so I am very proud of this! 

Ver 1.0.0
I don't plan on updating this mod unless its to reskin some other pets into junimos
This mod was created by me but the idea was a collaboration with Cuteyoshi
